401-2530-3944-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-5931.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

2099-3764-7924.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the Clue.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1680-4881-6909-6974.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
1680-4881-6909-6974.easyPrerequisites: Runed Stalactite is attached to Carnage.
1680-4881-6909-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3220-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3220-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2167-3861-4548-5721.easyPrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{B} (but see notes).
2167-3861-4548-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing each land you control, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{B}.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Takenuma from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, milling three cards and returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {1}{G}.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat
2167-3861-4548-5721.notes: Each legendary creature you control reduces the amount of mana required by {1}, up to a maximum of {3}. Each loop also has a chance to generate more mana than the one before it due to additional milled lands, so if you have excess mana you can begin the loop without the required number of lands and have a chance to achieve the infinite loop through milling.

586-864-2279-3125-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2279-3125-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

586-864-3125-7396-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-7396-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

1477-2111-3545.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-3062-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Pir
Repeat.

2079-3755-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2079-3755-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2079-3755-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2099-3490-4455-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2099-3490-4455-7426.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat

2034-3000-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-3000-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

296-3532-5078-7052.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-5078-7052.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

328-5220-5686-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-5220-5686-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-3263-4050-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Repeat.

500-1777-2556.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mnemonic Wall and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Mnemonic Wall tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Mnemonic Wall token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

851-3951-4452-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
851-3951-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

186-855-2060-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-855-2060-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

527-3812-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
527-3812-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1750-1979-4377-5261.notablePrerequisites: Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-1979-4377-5261.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Walk the Aeons from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Walk the Aeons from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

204-647-1858-2056-2633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-647-1858-2056-2633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

2292-3451-4191-4784.description:
Cast Augusta from your hand by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Augusta.
When Augusta dies, Death's Oasis triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Plargg from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

167-1303-2974-4050.description:
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Repository Skaab.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Repository Skaab, adding {B}.
When Repository Skaab dies, it triggers, as well as any Wicked Role token(s) that may be attached to it.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger(s), if applicable, causing each opponent to lose that much life.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, then creating a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Repository Skaab enters the battlefield, its exploit ability and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of it.
When the Repository Skaab token enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger from step 4, sacrificing the Repository Skaab token.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning Not Dead After All to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

969-3259-4538.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a land.
969-3259-4538.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Dune-Brood Nephilim and the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury and Dune-Brood Nephilim trigger.
Resolve the Dune-Brood Nephilim trigger, creating a 1/1 Sand creature token for each land you control.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Sand token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1350-1770-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{U}.
1350-1770-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

955-1548-1550.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to Maelstrom Wanderer.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Maelstrom Wanderer and Port Razer.
955-1548-1550.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Maelstrom Wanderer and Port Razer, triggering Sword of Hearth and Home and Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Hearth and Home trigger, exiling Port Razer, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Port Razer onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1309-1987-3830.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and the Island.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1722-1940-2034.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1722-1940-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Liliana, letting you draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

1283-1357-1987-3584.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery this turn.
1283-1357-1987-3584.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {3} tageting any two applicable permanents.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, creating at least one copy of Ghostly Flicker targeting any two applicable permanents.
Holding priority, activate Errant by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of any Ghostly Flicker copy targeting Errant and Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the first copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Errant and Chromattic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 4.
